summary: Moolec Science SA, a Nasdaq-listed Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching an EGM notice and proxy materials for a virtual meeting on October 20, 2026, seeking a special resolution to voluntarily wind up the company and appoint Cassandra Ronaldson and Amiel Gottlieb of Interpath (Cayman) Limited as Joint Voluntary Liquidators, authorize their remuneration, and permit retention of books and records for five years post-dissolution. No price, stake, premium, or advisor is stated. Watch for shareholder approval, dissolution timing, any residual distributions, and Nasdaq delisting mechanics.
